name: smartflow
responsibility: Package the complete WESEO SmartFlow workflow for WordPress/WST projects in one plugin: server-side WordPress and WST foundations, Section and CPT work, local frontend CSS/SCSS implementation, Playwright QA, and the documentation layer. Successor to the six legacy packages wordpress-server-ops, wst-builder, frontend-design-qa, and their -beta twins.
assumptions: The plugin is used in a Cursor workspace whose repository root is the wp-content level of a WESEO WordPress/WST project checkout; only the child theme subdirectory is deployed to the server.

Installing smartflow (or smartflow-beta) replaces all six legacy packages: wordpress-server-ops, wst-builder, frontend-design-qa, and their -beta twins. The plugin must not run next to any legacy package, and smartflow and smartflow-beta must never run together.

Project-specific CPT names, URL slugs, ACF keys, WPGB IDs, WordPress paths, URLs, credentials placeholders, and learned quirks live in the project-local PROJECT-CONTEXT.md and the project docs/ layer, never in reusable plugin content.

The agent never pushes: it commits and hands over to the user, who pushes to the remote; deployment reaches the server through the project deploy path and is verified over the project status bridge before QA continues.

rules.name: plugin-package-boundary
rules.description: Keep required SmartFlow workflows self-contained inside the plugin package and prevent development-only path dependencies.
